discriminator_result.verdict: RERANKER IS THE CULPRIT on LongMemEval-S
discriminator_result.reading: only ssu flips (0.60 vs 0.40), other 5 types identical; no-rerank 0.867 == mem0 same-30q 0.867; second independent evidence (after K50 null experiment) that cross-encoder rerank adds nothing on S-scale haystacks and hurts ssu; remaining ssu gap (0.60 vs mem0 0.80) points to embedder (bge-m3 vs text-embedding-005)
discriminator_result.action: full500 relaunched as m3-only (PID 2382896, /tmp/lme_500_norank.log, ~10h); M-scale rerank decision deferred to M experiments (501-sess haystack may genuinely need rerank)

final_verdict_full500.reading: statistical tie, each wins one metric: compass P@1 +1.0pt, mem0 P@5 +1.6pt; the 6.7pt mem0 edge on 30q converged to 1.6pt at n=500. compass P@5 deficit is entirely ssu (0.66 vs 0.87) + ssp (0.67 vs 0.97) while P@1 ties everywhere -> truth sessions stuck at rank 6-20.
final_verdict_full500.next_hypothesis: K=20 candidate-pool truncation caps deep recall (mem0 searches full store, no truncation); K50+no-rerank 30q arm running to decouple rerank-harm vs truncation-harm
final_verdict_full500.truncation_hypothesis: FALSIFIED: K50+hybrid+no-rerank == K20 same cfg == 0.867 (identical per-type); with no reranker K only widens the RRF fusion window, top5 unchanged. Remaining explanation: bge-m3 ranking quality itself (truth at cosine rank 6-20). Next ammo: Qwen3-4B (GPU) / utterance-level retrieval / dual-embedder RRF.

qwen3_result.reading: ku +1 but ssa -2 net wash; ssu gap needs utterance-level retrieval or Qwen3-4B (GPU-scale), not small-model swap
